managed_policies.reason: Reads the security configuration of every AWS service: IAM, network, encryption and logging settings.
Lists and describes resources across AWS services, so Act can inventory what exists.

permission_groups.label: Scan Kubernetes inside EKS clusters
permission_groups.description: Lets the role create a view-only EKS access entry for itself on each cluster and read Kubernetes objects through it.

permission_groups.label: CloudTrail logs
permission_groups.description: Lets the role read CloudTrail log files in S3 and log events in CloudWatch Logs, and decrypt them with KMS through those services.

permission_groups.label: AI services
permission_groups.description: Lets the role read Amazon Bedrock, Bedrock AgentCore, OpenSearch Serverless and SageMaker model package group details the AWS managed policies leave out.
